concepts.name: Giza Under the Stars
concepts.main_subject: The three Great Pyramids of Giza, seen from low ground level, glowing pale gold under a vast night sky
concepts.background: A deep indigo starfield fading into soft desert haze at the horizon, tiny wind-blown sand texture in the foreground dunes
concepts.composition: Pyramids placed slightly right of center along the upper third, a small soft-focus silhouette of a sleeping figure resting on a pillow tucked into the lower-left corner, generous negative sky above for text safety
concepts.lighting: Cool moonlight raking across the pyramid faces from the upper left, warm faint lantern glow near the sleeping silhouette for contrast
concepts.colors: Deep indigo and midnight blue sky, pale warm gold limestone, soft warm amber accent near the foreground figure
concepts.focal_emotion: Serene, unhurried stillness - the sleeping silhouette reads as peaceful and safe, not sleepy from fatigue
concepts.avoid: Do not add harsh sun-drenched daylight, tourists, camels, or any modern object; keep the sleeping figure small and silhouetted, not a detailed face

concepts.name: The Golden Barque of Ra
concepts.main_subject: A glowing golden figure of Ra seated at the center of an ornate wooden barque, radiating soft warm light
concepts.background: A boundless dark violet void with perfectly still black water reflecting the barque's glow
concepts.composition: Barque centered with generous symmetrical framing, faint ripples leading the eye inward, top third left open for a short title
concepts.lighting: A single warm internal glow from Ra himself as the only light source, gently rimming the boat's edges
concepts.colors: Deep violet and black, warm gold and amber glow, faint cool blue reflections in the water
concepts.focal_emotion: Awe and reverence, calm rather than dramatic - a gentle divine presence, not a threatening one
concepts.avoid: Do not make Ra's face detailed or expressive close-up; avoid any menacing or battle-like framing, keep it mythic and serene

concepts.name: River of the Pharaohs
concepts.main_subject: A low wooden reed boat with a single lit lantern at its prow, drifting down a wide dark river
concepts.background: Silhouetted palm groves and reeds along the banks, with the faint outline of pyramids on the far horizon
concepts.composition: Boat placed on the lower third following the rule of thirds, river leading diagonally into the distant pyramids, open dark sky above for text
concepts.lighting: A single warm lantern glow on the boat contrasted against cool moonlit water and sky
concepts.colors: Deep navy and black water, warm amber lantern light, faint silver moonlight on the ripples
concepts.focal_emotion: Quiet, unhurried drifting calm - a lone journey, not a lonely one
concepts.avoid: Do not clutter the riverbanks with too much detail, keep the pyramids on the horizon subtle rather than dominant

recommended_reason: The pyramids are the single most recognizable symbol of Ancient Egypt, giving instant subject clarity in a small thumbnail; pairing them with a small, calm sleeping silhouette immediately signals the sleep-story genre without resorting to clutter or misleading imagery, and the composition leaves clean negative space for a short title.
final_image_prompt: Cinematic painterly night scene of the three Great Pyramids of Giza viewed from low ground level, glowing pale warm gold under a vast deep indigo starfield. Cool moonlight rakes across the pyramid faces from the upper left. Soft wind-textured sand dunes fill the foreground, with a small, soft-focus silhouette of a peacefully sleeping figure resting against a pillow tucked into the lower-left corner, lit by a faint warm amber glow. Generous open sky above for title text. Historical illustration style, richly atmospheric, soft depth of field, no readable text or hieroglyphs baked into the image, no people other than the small sleeping silhouette, no modern objects, no camels or tourists, no harsh daylight, no watermarks, no distorted anatomy.
